messages:
Nina Park: Need a crisp customer-facing runbook for go-live priming focused on prefill/prefetch, batching presets, streaming fallback, and renewal-signal capture. One pager + 2-line email. Keep it simple.
Owen Li: Can we include a tiny "what we do" sentence for customers and a 3-item checklist they can copy?
Nina Park: Proposed opener: 'Well prefill a representative set of your prompts, maintain a small warm pool for core flows, and automatically fall back to polling if streaming shows instability. Well monitor a few simple metrics and reach out if we see issues.'
Maya Desai: Add renewal flag: 'If weekly active sessions drop >30% vs baseline for 72h, CS triggers a health call.' Simple.
Carlos Pena: ENG presets (copyable): Latency-first: batch_window_ms=60, max_batch_tokens=512; Balanced: batch_window_ms=150, max_batch_tokens=2048; Cost-first: batch_window_ms=350, max_batch_tokens=4096.
Nina Park: Customer prefill snippet (non-prod first):
```
# PREFILL (paste into your infra notes)
prefill: true
sample_size: 200
mode: "staggered"  # immediate | staggered | steady
warm_pool: 5
warm_pool_ttl_hours: 72
```
Owen Li: Observability (customer-friendly labels + thresholds): prefill_success_rate >= 90%, kv_cache_hit_rate >= 60%, p95_time_to_first_token_ms < 800, stream_disconnects_per_10k < 10. If breached, run escalation.
Maya Desai: Escalation playbook (short): 1) CS: collect 3 failing prompts and repro in non-prod; 2) ENG: verify cache keys & model pin; 3) ENG oncall: attach trace and enable temporary fallback.
Carlos Pena: Small curl example for ENG to toggle fallback (internal):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/fallbacks" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"fallback_mode":"polling","interval_ms":500}'
```
Nina Park: Customer email (2 lines): 'Were priming your instance and monitoring performance for the first 72h. If you see slowness or missing messages, reply with 2 examples and well investigate immediately.'
Owen Li: PromQL sample for p95 TTF (ENG note):
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Maya Desai: Small addition: add a one-liner customers can use in their UI when fallback occurs: 'Were temporarily using a polling mode to keep responses stable while we fix streaming.'
Nina Park: Action items: @Carlos finalize ENG presets and curl snippet; @Owen add PromQL queries to the tech appendix; @Maya draft the short email and renewal trigger wording. Ill compile and publish the one-pager to the CS drive and link in the playbook.
runbook-bot: New runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cs/go-live-primer-prefill-polling (access: customer-success, eng)
Carlos Pena: acked. Small note: point customers to Optimize for model/quantization guidance (we keep ops doc focused).
Nina Park: Perfect. Publishing draft EOD Friday. Drop any tiny snippets here and Ill fold them in. :rocket:
